title: Bacon, Egg, Onion & Tomato Muffin Filling
description: A scrambled egg muffin filling worked out in an earlier session. The method exists but the quantities were never written down.

items.note: To tighten the mix if loose

steps.text: Cook the bacon and onion separately. The Thermomix cannot brown either.
Deseed, salt and drain the tomato for 15 minutes. Tomato water is what ruins a muffin filling.
Scramble the eggs with the butterfly, about 6 min / 90°C / Reverse / Speed 2, checking at 5 minutes for a just-set result.
Fold everything through off the heat. Hold the salt until the end, since the bacon carries plenty.
